text: Artificial intelligence, or AI, is the ability of machines to perform tasks that usually require human intelligence. This includes learning, problem-solving, and understanding language. At its core, AI uses large amounts of data to improve its performance over time. A key part of this is machine learning, where computers learn from examples rather than following strict rules. A more advanced branch, called deep learning, uses complex networks inspired by the human brain to find patterns in data. You already use AI every day. For instance, voice assistants on your phone, product recommendations on shopping sites, and spam filters in your email all rely on this technology. While AI is powerful, it works best when designed to assist humans, not replace them.
